spec.anchor_rule: v1 = camera_sequence[C + k - 1] for k=1..64 (canonical seed-42 sequence; positions C+1..C+64)
spec.heldout_rule: 8 cameras, even stride over sorted complement of the anchor-view union; excludes all action views
spec.pool_rule: 7 partners by geometric overlap s=cos_dir/(1+d/d_ref), ties by camera index; high=ranks 1-3, medium=positions len//3 and 2len//3, low=two lowest
spec.a2_random_rule: per-scene frozen RNG stream random.Random(N1_SEED) over that scene's anchors in frozen order (checkpoint asc, anchor index asc), randint(0,6)
spec.backward_age_rule: C - last 1-based position <= C with that view
spec.geometry_only: no gradients or renders used for any selection

room.camera_sequence_source: canonical p12a run (30000, deterministic seed-42 stream; snapshot run's 25000-entry save verified prefix-identical)
